title: 第1644章 轮番登场第1643章 碾压依旧
content_zh:
“混沌……非无序，乃万物之始，亦万物之终。”
“归墟……非终结，乃轮回之环，亦新生之机。”
“我之道……乃衍变！于混沌中开辟，于归墟中新生！”
低沉道音自心底响起，回荡周身天地。
混沌衍道经全力运转，混沌、太虚、归墟三大至高真意完美融合，三千大道法则在周身流转轰鸣！
混沌噬道经奥义席卷四方，噬道、吞道、纳道、化道、掌道无上真谛迸发！以身为炉，以神魂为引，诸天万道尽被吞噬，万道之力尽数化为自身道果！
刹那间，漫天碾压而来的九大神通、无尽仙法、磅礴法则，尽数被混沌噬道之力锁定、牵引！
“万道归噬，混沌化源！”
张皓旸周身混沌力场暴涨，瞬间吞噬漫天所有神通术法、法则能量！
九名核心长老惊骇地发现，自己耗费毕生修为催动的顶级神通、半步神尊的磅礴仙力，竟然不受控制地被对方疯狂吞噬、掠夺、消解！
对方不仅不受攻击，反而以他们的神通、法则、仙力为养料，不断壮大自身修为、浑厚自身道基！
“不可能！世间怎会有此逆天功法！可吞噬万道、掠夺法则！”
九位核心长老瞳孔炸裂，满脸极致的难以置信，心神彻底震颤。
就在众人惊骇之际，张皓旸双手结印，催动无上本源印法—封天印！
“以吾混沌之心为引，纳诸天万界未散之灵机，聚太初鸿蒙未分之源气……演化混沌，划定乾坤……封！”
古朴苍茫的道音响彻万里天地，一道无边无际、混沌玄黄的巨大印法自虚空凝聚，镇压苍穹、笼罩八荒！
封天印落下，万里虚空瞬间被彻底封禁，空间凝固、法则静止、万法禁锢！
九名星君巅峰核心长老的身形瞬间被死死禁锢在虚空之中，动弹不得，一身磅礴修为、无上神通尽数被封天印镇压封印，无法运转半分！
随后，张皓旸抬手握剑，星河剑直指苍穹，周身九霄雷霆、归墟寂灭、太虚无形三重剑意完美交融，施展融合可归墟、太虚、混沌和大道九霄的无上剑法—混沌九霄！
一剑劈出，牵动天地本源法则，空间不再是撕裂，而是彻底崩塌！

无法描摹、超越诸天色彩的混沌剑光横贯长空，蕴含混沌初开、乾坤始奠的创世意境，亦承载万物归墟、诸天寂灭的终结奥义！
这一剑，超越境界桎梏，碾压一切道途！
“噗嗤！”“噗嗤！”“噗嗤！”
九道沉闷的碎裂声接连响起。
九名星君巅峰核心长老，连一句求饶之言都来不及说出，身躯、神魂、道基、本源尽数被混沌九霄剑光撕裂、湮灭、归墟！
九大核心，尽数陨落，无一幸免！
长空寂然，万里无声！
content_en:
"Chaos... is not disorder, it is the beginning and end of all things."
"Returning to ruins... is not the end, but the cycle of reincarnation and the opportunity for new life."
"My way... is evolution! It is opened up in the chaos and reborn in the ruins!"
The low voice sounded from the bottom of my heart, echoing throughout the world.
The Chaos Evolution Dao Sutra is operating at full strength, the three supreme true meanings of Chaos, Taixu, and Guixu are perfectly integrated, and the three thousand Dao Laws are flowing and roaring around the body!
The mysteries of the Chaos Devouring Dao Sutra sweep across all directions, and the supreme true meanings of Devouring Dao, Swallowing Dao, Accepting Dao, Transforming Dao, and Palm Dao burst out! Using the human body as a furnace and the divine soul as a guide, all the heavens and all the ways are swallowed up, and all the power of all the ways is turned into the fruit of one's own way!
In an instant, the nine great magical powers, endless immortal magic, and majestic laws that were crushing all over the sky were all locked and pulled by the power of the Chaos Devouring Dao!
"All things will be swallowed up, and the source of chaos will be transformed!"
The chaotic force field around Zhang Haoyang surged, instantly swallowing up all the magical powers, spells, and energy in the sky!
The nine core elders were horrified to find that the top-notch magical power and the majestic immortal power of the half-step god that they had spent their entire lives cultivating were being wildly devoured, plundered, and disintegrated by the opponent without control!
Not only are the opponents not attacked, but they use their magical powers, laws, and immortal power as nourishment to continuously strengthen their own cultivation and solidify their own foundation!
"Impossible! How can there be such a heaven-defying technique in the world! It can swallow all the ways and plunder the laws!"
The pupils of the nine core elders exploded, their faces were filled with extreme disbelief, and their hearts were completely shaken.
Just when everyone was horrified, Zhang Haoyang formed a seal with his hands and activated the supreme source seal - Sealing Heaven Seal!
"Using my chaotic heart as a guide, I will absorb the undissipated inspirations of all the heavens and worlds, gather the undivided source energy of the great beginning... evolve the chaos, demarcate the universe... and seal it!"
The ancient and vast sound of the Dao resounded throughout the world, and a boundless, chaotic and huge seal condensed from the void, suppressing the sky and covering the eight wastelands!
The Sealing Seal fell, and the void of thousands of miles was completely sealed in an instant. The space was solidified, the laws were still, and all laws were imprisoned!
The bodies of the nine core elders at the peak of Star Lord were instantly imprisoned in the void, unable to move. All their majestic cultivation and supreme magical powers were suppressed and sealed by the Sealing Seal, and they could not function even half a minute!
Then, Zhang Haoyang raised his hand to hold the sword, and pointed the Galaxy Sword directly at the sky. The three sword intentions of Nine Heavens Thunder, Guixu Nirvana, and Taixu Invisible Heavens perfectly blended around him, and he used the supreme sword technique of merging Guixu, Taixu, Chaos, and Dao Jiuxiao - Chaos Nine Heavens!
A sword slashed out, affecting the original laws of heaven and earth. The space was no longer torn apart, but completely collapsed!
The chaotic sword light that cannot be described and transcends the colors of the heavens stretches across the sky. It contains the artistic conception of the creation of the beginning of chaos and the beginning of the universe. It also carries the meaning of the end of the destruction of all things and the destruction of the heavens!
This sword transcends the shackles of realm and crushes all paths!
"Pfft!" "Pfft!" "Pfft!"
Nine dull cracking sounds sounded one after another.
The nine core elders of the peak Star Lord could not even say a word of begging for mercy. Their bodies, souls, foundations, and origins were all torn apart, annihilated, and returned to ruins by the Chaos Nine Heavens Sword Light!
All nine cores fell, no one was spared!
The sky is silent and there is no sound for thousands of miles!
